Application Data.NAME: Smith & Sons Carpentry
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith & Sons Carpentry specializes in custom woodworking and carpentry services, including the design and fabrication of bespoke furniture, cabinetry, and architectural woodwork. Our operations encompass both residential and commercial projects, where we prioritize quality craftsmanship and attention to detail. We also offer restoration and repair services for vintage furniture and properties, ensuring sustainable practices by utilizing reclaimed wood when possible. Safety measures are a top priority, with all work performed by trained professionals adhering to industry standards.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2022, a minor injury occurred when a worker sustained a laceration while operating a table saw. The injury required medical attention, costing approximately $2,500. The claim was filed and is currently closed. On 11/10/2021, a delivery truck was involved in a minor accident causing damage worth $2,500, which was settled and closed.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security cameras with motion sensors, perimeter fencing, and on-site security personnel during high-value projects.
